scope: Externally reachable operations that can move funds, submit external orders/transactions, change signing/custody authority, or activate paid value. Read-only and unsigned-prepare operations are excluded.

retryClasses.natural-identity: The operation carries an external immutable identity such as a chain transaction hash or identical signed transaction bytes. Retry only with the same identity.
retryClasses.explicit-idempotency-key: The caller supplies a durable operation identity; same identity must not produce a second effect.
retryClasses.durable-operation-id: A server-issued durable identity binds the operation across retries.
retryClasses.unsafe-auto-retry: A timeout or ambiguous failure can duplicate the effect. Reconcile state before any retry.

agent.swap.execute.identitySource: Idempotency-Key header; fallback quote_id/approval_id for legacy callers
agent.swap.execute.sameRequest: same client key and economic fingerprint reuses the managed execution identity
agent.swap.execute.conflictingReuse: same client key with different economic terms receives a distinct fingerprint and cannot be mistaken for the prior trade
agent.swap.execute.concurrent: approval consumption/cap reservation and downstream execution identity prevent duplicate approved execution
agent.swap.execute.unknownOutcome: network timeout, abort, connection failure, or downstream 5xx is treated as outcome-unknown; credits are not blindly refunded and the caller must reconcile
agent.swap.execute.reconciliation: GET /v1/agent/swap/status/:swapId or chain transaction status once a hash is known

agent.billing.topup.identitySource: source-chain txHash plus chain in the consumed-payments ledger
agent.billing.topup.sameRequest: reusing the same consumed payment returns the previously credited result instead of crediting again
agent.billing.topup.conflictingReuse: one chain transaction can be consumed only once globally across payment purposes
agent.billing.topup.concurrent: database unique constraint on (chain, tx_hash) resolves races
agent.billing.topup.unknownOutcome: retry with the same chain transaction identity; never pay again merely because the client lost the HTTP response

agent.billing.subscribe.identitySource: source-chain txHash plus chain in the consumed-payments ledger
agent.billing.subscribe.sameRequest: the same payment cannot activate a second subscription grant
agent.billing.subscribe.conflictingReuse: one chain transaction can be consumed only once globally across payment purposes
agent.billing.subscribe.concurrent: database unique constraint on (chain, tx_hash) resolves races
agent.billing.subscribe.unknownOutcome: retry only with the same payment identity and inspect billing state before sending another payment

agent.billing.recurring.identitySource: signed Base Spend Permission fields; no verified unique database key currently binds duplicate registrations
agent.billing.recurring.concurrent: not proven; recurring_subscriptions currently lacks a dedicated uniqueness constraint for the permission identity
agent.billing.recurring.unknownOutcome: inspect recurring subscription state before retrying; do not create a second permission registration blindly

agent.prediction.place-order.identitySource: currently a fresh random order salt and timestamp are generated on each request
agent.prediction.place-order.sameRequest: a retry can create a second distinct signed CLOB order
agent.prediction.place-order.conflictingReuse: no Suwappu client operation key exists today
agent.prediction.place-order.concurrent: two concurrent requests can submit two independent orders
agent.prediction.place-order.unknownOutcome: query open orders / venue state before any retry; never blindly repeat after timeout

agent.prediction.cancel-order.sameRequest: provider duplicate-cancel semantics are not yet contract-tested
agent.prediction.cancel-order.unknownOutcome: inspect open-order state before retrying a failed/ambiguous cancel

agent.wallet.create.identitySource: agent identity; Turnkey sub-organization creation is not currently guarded by a Suwappu idempotency record
agent.wallet.create.sameRequest: duplicate sub-organization/wallet creation is not proven impossible under ambiguous failure
agent.wallet.create.unknownOutcome: list managed wallets and inspect agent metadata before retrying

agent.wallet.policy.create.identitySource: no client operation key; provider creates a policy
agent.wallet.policy.create.sameRequest: duplicate policy creation is not proven impossible

agent.wallet.policy.delete.sameRequest: provider duplicate-delete semantics are not contract-tested
agent.wallet.policy.delete.unknownOutcome: list policies before retrying; protected non-agent policies remain undeletable

public-swap.execute.identitySource: optional idempotencyKey request field persisted on swap record
public-swap.execute.sameRequest: safe duplicate suppression depends on the caller supplying the same key; omission leaves no durable client retry identity
public-swap.execute.conflictingReuse: database swap identity exists only when a key is supplied
public-swap.execute.concurrent: not proven safe when the client omits idempotencyKey
public-swap.execute.unknownOutcome: reconcile swap status/chain state before retry; never blindly retry an omitted-key execution

terminal.swap.execute.identitySource: quoteId forwarded to SwapEngine as idempotency_key
terminal.swap.execute.sameRequest: the same quoteId preserves execution identity
terminal.swap.execute.conflictingReuse: quote identity binds the quoted economic request
terminal.swap.execute.unknownOutcome: reuse the same quoteId and reconcile recorded/chain state rather than generating a new execution identity
terminal.swap.execute.reconciliation: Terminal activity/swap status and chain state

terminal.swap.submit-jito.identitySource: identical already-signed Solana VersionedTransaction bytes / transaction signature
terminal.swap.submit-jito.sameRequest: safe retry requires resubmitting identical signed bytes, never rebuilding/re-signing the transaction
terminal.swap.submit-jito.conflictingReuse: different signed bytes are a different transaction and must not inherit the old retry identity
terminal.swap.submit-jito.concurrent: identical signed transaction identity is preserved across duplicate submissions
terminal.swap.submit-jito.unknownOutcome: derive/inspect the transaction signature and chain/Jito state before creating any new signed transaction
terminal.swap.submit-jito.reconciliation: Solana transaction signature status, then POST /webapp/swap/record

terminal.swap.record.sameRequest: transaction hash is the record identity
terminal.swap.record.conflictingReuse: a different transaction hash is a different record
terminal.swap.record.concurrent: database idempotency key owns duplicate record suppression
terminal.swap.record.unknownOutcome: inspect the same transaction hash and recorded activity before re-recording
terminal.swap.record.reconciliation: Terminal activity plus chain transaction status

excludedBoundaries.agent.swap.prepare: POST /v1/agent/swap returns an unsigned self-custody transaction and does not broadcast funds.
excludedBoundaries.rewards.claim.prepare: POST /webapp/rewards/claim returns unsigned claim calldata; client signs/broadcasts.
excludedBoundaries.staking: Current api-ts staking surface is read-only.
excludedBoundaries.smart-account: Current api-ts smart-account surface predicts/configures only and does not send UserOperations.
excludedBoundaries.p2p.escrow: Current webapp P2P escrow/take execution is disabled; no live fund-moving endpoint is exposed there.
